Submit your result with submit_audit. Use PASS if all four partners can attend, and FAIL if any partner has a conflict.

I agree that a "Busy" block is our most promising lead for finding a movable conflict. Since that slot is clear on my end, please go ahead and check if Priya is able to move her appointment. If she can, let me know and I'll send out the confirmation email once you've booked it.
